component.name: Bulp
component.summary: Control your Elgato lights from the desktop

description.p: Turn Elgato Key Lights, Ring Lights and Light Strips on and off and adjust their brightness and color temperature, right from your desktop. Lights on the local network are found automatically.

ul.li: Tray icon with a quick on/off menu (where the desktop has a tray)
Control panel with brightness, color temperature and color
Talks to the lights directly over your network; no account or cloud

description.p: This is an unofficial app, not affiliated with or endorsed by Elgato or Corsair.
Better for scripts and AI agents:

ul.li: The CLI's JSON output is one list with each light's name, address and color temperature in Kelvin
BULP_HOST and -host accept several lights, and -name works together with them
An agent skill (skills/bulp) teaches AI agents how to control the lights
